lines: Uh-huh-huh! You fight better than expected, Octo-Girl!! Az a reward I'll gut you like a fish!
At a speed barely visible to the naked eye, Hebiko's ninjato and the Blue Oni's spear were blending together.
Hebiko's fast Four Blade Style should have been effective against an opponent wielding a long weapon. However, the Blue Oni handled his spear with ease and effortlessly parried Hebiko's attacks.
(So this is how Oni fight...! Calling them a race of fighters was not just empty talk.)
I watched the fighting of one of the renowned Oni and trembled as I forgot about the situation at hand.
Meanwhile his demonic beast continued causing trouble. It was rushing into gaps in the fight to bite at Hebiko's legs, and she had already lost her footing several times.
If the fight dragged on and backup were called, we would be at a disadvantage in an instant.
Hebiko's full-force octopus ink blast covered the Blue Oni's head.
!!? What iz this!? What did you do to me!!?
Hebiko dodged the confused and wildly flailing Blue Oni and swiftly withdrew to my side. Thenー
Hebiko used her octopus tentacles to jump onto the wall of a building about 5 stories high.
As I was flung around like a bungee jumper, we leapt over buildings and through the streets and escaped from the Blue Oni.
H-Hebiko! That's enough, let me down!
Pheeeew, you were so heavy! Fuma-chan, what the hell did you get yourself into!?
We arrived in a motel district lined with Western-style buildings.
Women in flashy outfits stood on every street corner. The business they conducted in the motels must have been booming.
It came to the point where you were being chased down by an Oni, so it's not something trivial!
Yeah, I know, I'm already sick of it.
For now let's head toward the station. They probably won't follow us outside of the black market district.
At that moment, the alley suddenly got noisy.
They're here again! Close the shutters!
It didn't seem to be our pursuers.
A faint vibrating sound was echoing through the street. It was getting louder and louderー
Down the street, the motel windows were breaking one by one.
What the hell is going on?

▪ Again...
▪ This is the third time at our place.
▪ It feels stupid even fixing them.
The residents, however, didn't seem too surprised and cleaned up the glass with fed-up looks on their faces.
The residents here seem used to it. What the hell was that...?
Fuma-chan, get out of the way!
Just as the sound got closer, something flew past us at a ridiculous speed.
The sound eventually became more distant and could no longer be heard.
Something like wings flapping...? Almost like a poltergeist...
We looked at each other. But for now we had to get to the stati... hmm?
Wait, waaaiiit!! ...Minasaki, is this the right way??
I quickly stepped in front of the little devils who were trying to run away.
Gyaaa! Wh-What are you gonna do to us─?!!
Cweepー! Kidnapping pwetty girlsーーー!!!!
...What are you doing, Fuma-chan? Do you know them?
Hebiko... I'll explain everything later. For now I have to give those two a good beating...
I spoke without taking my eyes off them, and even the two little devils seemed to understand the situation they were in.
Ugh... So for us to go on, Chief must go down...
I knew we were destined to fight from the moment we met, Chief.
The two demons and I were glaring at each other. Hebiko was looking confused.
Listen, don't ever call me Chief again...
The tension of an unavoidable confrontation filled the nighttime alleyway.
